Title: Azure Site Recovery supports NetApp Private Storage

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery (ASR) can replicate and recover a SAN-based, on-premises Hyper-V workload to Azure with NetApp Private Storage (NPS). Enterprise customers can connect Azure compute emulator resources to the NetApp Private Storage collocated in Equinix datacenters over the Equinix Cloud Exchange. For more information about how to set up replication and disaster recovery for your SAN-based Hyper-V workloads to NPS:
  •  Check out this whitepaper, which details the solution configuration and testing: Azure Site Recovery with SAN Replication to NetApp Private Storage for Microsoft Azure
  • Watch this demo video on Channel 9: Azure Site Recovery.
  • Read this Azure blog: ASR Now Supports NetApp Private Storage for Microsoft Azure
